name: Halfling
summary: Small, cheerful folk who love home, food and good company. Halflings are hard to scare, slip past bigger folk easily, and have a knack for luck at the right moment.

age.summary: Halflings come of age at 20 and often live into their second century.

alignment.summary: Most halflings are lawful good: kind-hearted and fond of order and tradition.

size.description: Halflings stand about 3 feet tall and weigh around 40 pounds.

speed.description: Your base walking speed is 25 feet.

languages.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Halfling.

features.name: Lucky
features.summary: When you roll a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll, ability check or saving throw, you can reroll it and must use the new roll.

features.name: Brave
features.summary: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

features.name: Halfling Nimbleness
features.summary: You can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than you.

sublineages.name: Lightfoot Halfling
sublineages.summary: Lightfoots are easygoing travelers who blend in and hide well.

features.name: Naturally Stealthy
features.summary: You can try to hide even when only obscured by a creature at least one size larger than you.

sublineages.name: Stout Halfling
sublineages.summary: Stouts are hardier than other halflings; some say there is dwarf blood in them.

features.name: Stout Resilience
features.summary: You have advantage on saving throws against poison and resistance to poison damage.
